title: Indigo | Layered Bar Pendant Necklace
bodyHtml:
This layered necklace draws the eye with understated sophistication, combining two delicate strands in a graceful interplay of light. The bar pendant hangs with perfect balance, adding character without weighing you down—whether you're styling it under an open shirt or over a slip dress. It's the kind of minimal detail that somehow makes everything feel more intentional.

Why you'll love it

  • Two-strand design comes beautifully paired—no fiddling with tangled chains
  • The bar pendant adds a touch of modern elegance that flatters your neckline
  • Adjustable chain with secure clasp means it fits perfectly, every time
  • Lightweight and doesn't irritate—wear it all day, all week without a second thought
  • Rare and considered piece that works with everything from weekend casual to evening out
  • Stays brilliant through daily wear, holding its lustre season after season
  • Works as hard as you do: dress it up or down, and it just belongs
